subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB400
title: Exempts removal-fill projects from the requirement to obtain a permit from the Department of State Lands if the person is required to and does obtain a permit from the United States Army Corps of Engineers.
headline: SB 400 did not pass

claims.text: SB 400 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 400 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
